extras.real_size: hand axe (bearded axe), 45 cm (head approx. 15 cm deep, edge 13 cm)
extras.notes: short, gently curved oval ash handle with brass butt cap and leather wrap with brass ring; compact steel bearded head with softly rounded edge and round corners, socket with small rounded poll, two brass rivets on the blade neck and a brass wedge in the eye; lies flat on the ground (z = 0), long axis = X (head at +X), edge towards -Y; no moving parts; no text

origin.detail: Built procedurally with Blender scripts. The scripts were written with the help of an AI coding assistant. No generative AI model produced the geometry or textures directly.
